culture.name: India
culture.homeTravelNote: a long flight of a day or more door to door

cookLines: Mustard seeds crackle in the pan and the whole apartment smells like home.
You taste the dal and add a pinch more salt, the way your mother would.
{roommate} wanders in and asks what smells so good.
You share a plate at the counter, and for an hour the world is small and warm.

festivals.title: Diwali far from home
festivals.body: Diwali falls on a weekday. At home there would be lamps, sweets and family. Here it is just another Tuesday, with a quiz in the morning.
festivals.join: Go to the student association's Diwali night.
festivals.joinText: Rows of little lamps, too many sweets and a dance floor. For a few hours it feels like home.
festivals.host: Light lamps and cook for your friends.
festivals.hostText: Your apartment fills with friends and smoke from the kitchen. Someone video-calls their grandmother to show her.
festivals.skip: Call home and study for the quiz.
festivals.skipText: Your family holds the phone up to the lamps. You smile, and then you study.

festivals.title: Holi on a campus lawn
festivals.body: The student association organizes a Holi event. Colors fly, music plays, and people who have never seen it before are laughing and joining in.
festivals.joinText: You come home pink and green to the ears, with a voice gone hoarse from laughing.
festivals.host: Volunteer to run the color stall.
festivals.hostText: You explain the festival thirty times and enjoy it every time.
festivals.skip: Watch for a while, then head to the library.
festivals.skipText: You catch the music on the way out, and a little color on your sleeve.

familyCall: The call connects after three tries. Your mother's face fills the screen.
She asks if you are eating. You say yes and she looks unconvinced.
Your father waves from the background, pretending not to listen.
You hang up with a lump in your throat and a lighter chest.
culture.homeMoneyNote: Money from home is converted from rupees, and every swing in the exchange rate shows up in your account.
